summary: Each active newsletter has a public signup page, including an embeddable form, that still uses double opt-in.
detailed_changes: Added GET and POST /newsletters/{slug}/signup for active newsletters. Archived newsletters return 404.
The form posts through the existing consent flow and shows accessible success and validation errors.
?embed=1 renders the form without the public site chrome so it can be linked or iframed.
affected_areas: User groups affected: public visitors joining newsletters
Public impact: newsletter-specific signup with confirmation email
Internal impact: channel list signup at /mailing/signup is unchanged
